citizenCharterSummary: The CivicConnect Municipal Grievance Charter establishes time-bound grievance response, transparent departmental allocation, and non-discriminatory municipal public services.
charterCommitment1: Digital acknowledgment within 60 minutes of grievance submission.
charterCommitment2: Transparent allocation to the jurisdictional zonal engineer or department officer.
charterCommitment3: Strict SLA adherence based on category urgency with public countdown tracking.
charterCommitment4: Ground-level photo and milestone verification before complaint closure.
charterCommitment5: Right to reopen or appeal unverified or substandard grievance resolutions within 7 days.
rtiSummary: In accordance with public-sector transparency mandates, municipal operations, public works tenders, and grievance audit logs are maintained for citizen scrutiny.
rtiGuideline1: Public Information Officer (PIO) nodal contact available at Central Municipal Zone desk.
rtiGuideline2: Grievance audit trail documents, reference IDs, and departmental resolution logs may be requested.
rtiGuideline3: Standard statutory response timelines apply as per prevailing Right to Information rules.
rtiGuideline4: For proactive disclosure and budget inquiries, consult the municipal administrative portal.

faqReportIssueQuestion: How do I report a new issue?
faqReportIssueAnswer: Click New Complaint, fill in the details and submit. Your report will then appear under My Reports.
faqReportStatusesQuestion: What do the report statuses mean?
faqReportStatusesAnswer: Pending means your report is waiting for review. In Progress means it is being worked on. Resolved means the issue has been fixed.
faqTrackReportsQuestion: How can I track my reports?
faqTrackReportsAnswer: Open My Reports to see all your complaints and their current status. The Dashboard also shows your most recent reports.
faqReportUpdatesQuestion: Where do I see updates on my reports?
faqReportUpdatesAnswer: Status updates and alerts appear on the Notifications page.
faqContactSupportAnswer: Open the Contact tab on this page and email us. We will get back to you as soon as possible.
